title: Page 7
content_zh:
“你……”好个伶牙俐齿的丫头。

“好个贤妇好女，难怪皇弟都敢跟朕大眼瞪小眼的，非要朕玉成你们这段良缘。”果然明眸皓齿，肤白胜雪，盈盈一笑似芙蓉，是个美人儿。

“皇兄。”

“皇上。”

“免礼，自家人不用多礼，昨儿个政务繁忙，没到静王府为你主婚，今日朕特意来瞧瞧小俩口好不好，别把朕记恨上了。”上官禹打趣地呵呵笑着，他的五官比较像太后。

“不敢记恨，臣弟还要多谢皇兄成全，这才能抱得美人入怀。”该有的场面话上官静还是会说。

上官禹态度亲昵地坐在太后身侧，轻扶她枯枝似的手臂。“母后，你瞧瞧，小十七都成亲了，以后你不用担心他身边少了个知情识趣的妙人儿，赵家的大女儿不就是他的良缘。”

女儿就女儿，特意点出个“大”字，皇帝立意不良，他似乎有意无意让人联想到抬入东宫的二女儿，两人是一对同日出生的双生姊妹。

“就是年纪小了些，哀家看她好似不好生养的样子，咱们皇室最不能少的是子嗣，孩子多才有福气。”一个小丫头片子，她还治不了吗？静王想护着还看她肯不肯。

太后满是皱褶的眼一眯，锐光一闪。

“是呀！兴武侯不是说要等女儿及笄后再成婚，怎么就急了呢！”上官禹似在说着玩笑话，但话中有话的暗示：你们是不是有事瞒着朕呀！对朕的处置不满是不？

“处置”是指赵若瑜，身为皇上胡乱指婚，明明连世子、郡王都嫁得的权贵嫡女却许给自家儿子为妾，皇上呀！你也糊涂，存心打老臣脸面，叫臣子如何信服，你毁人亲女一生呀！

上官禹自个儿都心虚，圣旨一发就想追回，可是一想到静王竟敢拒婚，拿出先帝的遗旨逼他妥协，他也想给人找不痛快，索性就算在兴武侯府头上，谁叫静王看上的就是你家大女儿。

“妾身祖父梦见自己将不久于人世，他一醒来全身冷汗涔涔，妾身是祖父最疼宠的孙女，他怕梦境成真，见不到妾身出阁，便私下找来王爷商量，提早几个月过门。”她还有三个月及笄，说来也差不多可以嫁了。

祖父，你就替你的乖孙女多担待了，改日下棋我不赢你棋了。赵若瑾在心里偷乐，信口拈来的说法顺得不结巴，就是有点对不起祖父，让他欺君一回了。

上官禹了然的一点头，“原来如此，武官向来忌讳这种事，难怪他要着急了，两个孙女一个当了朕的儿媳，一个成了朕的弟媳，这辈分真有些乱了，你们自个儿斟酌。”

有他赐婚甥舅来得乱吗？这才真的叫不要脸吧！为了巩固自己的皇权，不惜让静王生下不健康的下一代，背负不堪入耳的骂名也无所谓。

赵若瑾在心里骂皇上虚伪，戴着假仁假义的面具行迫害之实，他要是真贤明就不会不顾西南百姓疾苦，一心打压手足。

“皇上，难为静王年过二十才迎正妃，王府中冷清毫无生气，哀家身边这两个丫头也是出身书香门第，一个叫冬妍，一个叫语宁，就赐给他当侧妃。”小俩口别太感激她，她也是为了绵延皇家子孙。太后脸上挂着慈和笑意。

名叫冬妍、语宁的两名宫女立即笑逐颜开，欢喜得找不着边了，她们原本是选秀的秀女，因入不了皇上的眼才派到慈宁宫服侍，本来以为今生无望了，要等到二十五岁放出宫，没想到时来运转，会被太后送出去，还是到本朝最俊美的王爷身边当侧妃。

殊不知她们在高兴之际，赵若瑾也在暗暗嘀咕，太后此举分明在打脸嘛！什么冬妍、语宁，让人不由得想起秦若妍、宁语嫣，太后真阴险，连这点小事也算计。

“太后不宜。”上官静面冷如霜的拒绝。

“你想抗旨？”太后大帽子一压。

“除非太后想背上气死老臣的罪名。”你有张良计，我有过墙梯，他可是她的亲生儿子，太后为何就是这般不待见他？

“气死大臣？”她一怔。

“莫忘了儿臣刚娶了兴武侯爷的嫡长女，王妃一向深受老侯爷疼爱，宠若明珠，今日不过成亲的第二日，尚未三日回门，恕儿臣说句冒犯皇兄的话，当你赐婚赵二小姐为太子良媛已非常不厚道了，老侯爷气得眼眶都红了，说要找先帝说说理。”

“这……”皇上迟疑了。

“是呀！我祖父在我出阁的前一日对着我嚎哭，说皇家已经毁了他一个孙女，若是日后妾身再受委屈，他就一头撞死在先帝陵墓前的石柱，以一死求先帝显灵，为妾身讨公道。”

鬼神之说最能震慑人。

贼夫妻、贼夫妻，还有比他们更合适的夫妻吗？一搭一唱配合得天衣无缝，不用眼神交会便能编出足以叫人心惊的说词，把大楚朝身分最高的两位唬得几乎无语，目露不安。

赐妃是小事，但逼死军中威望甚高的老将军，那绝对会引发朝廷动荡，文官笔诛，武官闹事，把太后的好意当乱朝之源，意在让文武百官不和好让后宫干政，牝鸡司晨。

尤其以赵老侯爷刚烈的性格，他还真有可能撞柱而亡，兴武侯府不认赵二小姐便足以说明对皇家的不满，但他们忠于君王，便是羞辱也忍着吞下，可若是真把他们的血气激发了，

怕是皇上也遏阻不了，拚着一死也要上金銮殿与皇上死干。

第十二章 宫中乱象(2)

“你们这是在威胁哀家吗？”太后一张垂肉的老脸气得铁青，老皮粗糙的手往扶手上一拍。

因为生上官静时把身子弄坏了，她养了几年还是养不回来，身体状况一年不如一年，老化现象相当严重，不像个养尊处优的太后，全身皮肤皱干干地，有如老树皮。

“太后息怒，儿媳说的并无虚言，若是太后认为儿媳不配为静王妃，那就一封休书送往兴武侯府，儿媳祖父自会领儿媳回府。”就是逼你，老太婆！太后就能为所欲为吗？

“胡闹，不过两个出身低微的宫女罢了，不要就不要，哪能闹得老将军出面，朕作主不赐侧妃了，省得皇弟跟朕闹。”他要做的是安抚人心，而不是把静王惹毛了。

“皇上，连你也要忤逆哀家吗？不就两个女人，赵无极那老头也敢对皇家叫嚣，他要死就让他去死，哀家就怕他死不了。”她就不信往静王后宅送人会闹出人命。

看太后还火上加油，着实头疼的上官禹冷着脸。“母后，你逾越了，前朝官员由朕管辖，你不得指手画脚。”

“皇上也给哀家摆脸色了是不是？我这把年纪了还能活多久，想看到静王子嗣出世有什么不对？两个儿子都不孝……”吓！他……静王做了什么？他竟然敢……敢……

“母后，儿臣替你解决了。”

没人看清上官静做了什么，只见他甩手一扔，两道人影被抛甩出去，落地时成扭曲状。

上官禹目光骤冷，低视先前还活色生香，如今已是脸色灰白的宫女，两人一个断手，一个断脚，相信她们有生之年都不敢再接近静王，要不然下一个断的大概就是她们的颈项了。

“皇弟你……”上官禹见状心有惧意，看来若是静王想杀他是轻而易举，他修润如玉的手指便是凶器。

“皇兄，母后，以后别为了这种事费心，再美的女人若不是心头爱也是红粉骷髅，塞再多给我也没用。你们把皇权看得比亲情还重，但不表示我也有相同想法，于我，那只是粪土。”他头一回明说他不要，众人争得你死我活的皇位，还不如妻子的盈盈一笑。
content_en:
"You..." What a sharp-tongued girl.

"What a virtuous woman. No wonder the emperor's younger brother dares to look at me with big eyes and small eyes. He insists that I make you a good match." Sure enough, she has bright eyes and white teeth, her skin is as white as snow, and her smile is as white as a hibiscus. She is a beauty.

"Brother Royal."

"Your Majesty."

"No gifts, I don't need to be too polite. I was busy with government affairs yesterday, so I didn't go to Prince Jing's Mansion to marry you. Today I came here specifically to see if the young couple is doing well, so don't make me hate you." Shangguan Yu laughed jokingly, his facial features were more like the Queen Mother's.

"I don't dare to bear grudges. I have to thank the emperor for my support, so that I can hold the beauty in my arms." Shangguan Jing would still say it when the situation should be met.

Shangguan Yu sat next to the Queen Mother in an affectionate manner and gently held her arm like a dead branch."Mother, look, Xiao Qi is already married. From now on, you don't have to worry about him losing an informed and interesting person. Isn't the eldest daughter of the Zhao family a good match for him?"

Daughter means daughter, and he specifically uses the word "big". The emperor has bad intentions. He seems to be intentionally or unintentionally reminiscent of the second daughter who was carried into the East Palace. The two are twin sisters born on the same day.

"It's just that she's a bit young. The Ai family seems to think that she has trouble giving birth. The most indispensable thing for our royal family is heirs. Only those with many children will be blessed." Can't she cure a little girl?King Jing wants to protect her and see if she is willing.

The Queen Mother's wrinkled eyes narrowed and a sharp light flashed.

"Yes! Didn't Marquis Xingwu say that he would wait until his daughter reaches the age of hairpin before getting married? Why are you in such a hurry!" Shangguan Yu seemed to be joking, but there was a hint in his words: Are you hiding something from me?Are you dissatisfied with my handling?

"Disposal" refers to Zhao Ruoyu. As the emperor, he made random arrangements for marriage, but he promised his own son as a concubine to the legitimate daughter of a powerful man who could even marry the prince and the prince. Your Majesty!You are also confused, deliberately trying to humiliate me and convince me, you are ruining the life of your own daughter!

Shangguan Yu felt guilty himself, and wanted to take back the imperial edict as soon as it was issued, but when he thought that King Jing dared to refuse the marriage and took out the late emperor's will to force him to compromise, he also wanted to make others unhappy, so he simply went to Xingwuhou's house. Who told King Jing to fall in love with your eldest daughter.

"My grandfather dreamed that he would die soon. When he woke up, he was covered in cold sweat. I was my grandfather's favorite granddaughter. He was afraid that the dream would come true and he would not see me come out of the palace, so he privately approached the prince to discuss the marriage a few months earlier." She was still three months old and had hair extensions, so she was almost ready to get married.

Grandfather, just take care of your good granddaughter. I won’t beat you in chess another day.Zhao Ruojin was secretly amused in her heart, and the words she spewed out from her mouth went smoothly without stammering, but she felt a little sorry for her grandfather for letting him deceive the king.

Shangguan Yu nodded in understanding, "I see, the military attache has always been taboo about this kind of thing. No wonder he is anxious. One of the two granddaughters has become my daughter-in-law, and the other has become my sister-in-law. This generational hierarchy is really confusing. You can decide for yourself."

Is it going to be chaotic if he has a nephew whom he has granted marriage to?This is really shameless!In order to consolidate his imperial power, he did not hesitate to let King Jing give birth to an unhealthy next generation, and it did not matter if he was burdened with unbearable infamy.

Zhao Ruojin scolded the emperor in his heart for being hypocritical and wearing a mask of hypocrisy and righteousness to persecute him. If he was really wise, he would not ignore the suffering of the people in the southwest and focus on suppressing his brothers.

"Your Majesty, it is difficult for King Jing to welcome his concubine only after he was over twenty years old. The palace is deserted and lifeless. The two girls next to the Ai family are also from scholarly families. One is named Dong Yan and the other is Yu Ning, so I gave him the title of concubine." The young couple did not want to be too grateful to her. She also wanted to continue the royal lineage.The Queen Mother had a kind smile on her face.

The two palace maids named Dong Yan and Yu Ning immediately burst into smiles and were so happy that they could not find anything else to do. They were originally the show girls in the draft, but they were sent to serve in the Cining Palace because they could not catch the emperor's eye. They originally thought that this life was hopeless and they would have to wait until they were twenty-five to be released from the palace. However, as time went by, they would be sent out by the Queen Mother, or they would become concubines to the most handsome prince in the dynasty.

Little did they know that while they were happy, Zhao Ruojin was also muttering secretly that the Queen Mother's move was clearly a slap in the face!Dong Yan and Yu Ning, people can't help but think of Qin Ruoyan and Ning Yuyan. The Queen Mother is so sinister, she even plots such trivial matters.

"Not suitable for the Queen Mother." Shangguanjing refused with a cold face.

"You want to resist the decree?" The Queen Mother said with a big hat.

"Unless the Queen Mother wants to be blamed for angering the old minister to death." You have a good plan, and I have a wall ladder. He is her biological son. Why does the Queen Mother dislike him so much?

"Is the minister so angry?" She was startled.

"Don't forget that I have just married the eldest daughter of the Marquis of Xingwu. The princess has always been loved by the old Marquis and favored her like a pearl. Today is only the second day of the wedding and she has not returned home in three days. I forgive you for saying anything that offends the emperor. When you marry Miss Zhao Er to the Crown Prince Liangyuan, it is already very unkind. The old Marquis was so angry that his eyes were red and he said that he wanted to talk to the late emperor to reason."

"This..." The emperor hesitated.

"Yes! My grandfather cried to me the day before I came out of the cabinet, saying that the royal family had ruined one of his granddaughters. If I was wronged again in the future, he would smash his head against the stone pillar in front of the late emperor's mausoleum and die to pray to the late emperor to appear and seek justice for my concubine."

The talk of ghosts and gods can shock people the most.

A thief couple, a thief couple, is there any more suitable couple than them?The singing and singing coordinated perfectly, and they were able to compose shocking words without making eye contact, which frightened the two highest-ranking people in the Great Chu Dynasty to the point where they were almost speechless and looked uneasy.

Granting a concubine is a trivial matter, but forcing the death of a highly respected veteran general in the army will definitely lead to turmoil in the court, with civil servants punished and military officers causing trouble. The Queen Mother's good intentions are regarded as the source of chaos in the court, with the intention of causing discord among the civil and military officials so that the harem can interfere in politics.

Especially with Zhao Laohou's strong character, he might really hit the pillar and die. The fact that the Xingwu Marquis Mansion did not recognize Miss Zhao Er was enough to show their dissatisfaction with the royal family. However, they were loyal to the king and would endure humiliation. But if their blood was really aroused,

I'm afraid that even the emperor can't stop him, and I will risk my life to go to the Jinluan Palace to fight with the emperor.

Chapter 12 Chaos in the Palace (2)

"Are you threatening the Ai family?" The Queen Mother's old, dewlap face was livid with anger, and she slapped the armrest with her rough hands.

Because her body was damaged when she gave birth to Shangguanjing, she still couldn't recover after several years of raising her. Her physical condition deteriorated year by year, and her aging was quite serious. She didn't look like a pampered queen mother. Her skin was wrinkled and dry, like the bark of an old tree.

"The Queen Mother, calm down. What my daughter-in-law said is true. If the Queen Mother thinks that her daughter-in-law is not worthy of being Princess Jing, then she will send a letter of divorce to the Xingwu Marquis Mansion, and her grandfather will take her back to the Mansion." I am forcing you, old woman!Can the Queen Mother do whatever she wants?

"It's nonsense. They are just two palace maids of humble origin. If you don't want them, don't want them. How can you make the old general come forward? I will decide not to give the concubine to me, so as to save the emperor's younger brother from making trouble with me." What he wanted to do was to appease people's hearts, not to piss off King Jing.

"Your Majesty, do you also want to disobey the Ai family? Not only two women, but the old man Zhao Wuji dared to shout at the royal family, if he wants to die, let him die. The Ai family is afraid that he will not die." She did not believe that sending people to Queen Jing's house would cause death.

Seeing that the Queen Mother was still irritated, Shangguan Yu, who really had a headache, had a cold face."Mother, you have gone too far. The officials of the previous dynasty are under my jurisdiction. You are not allowed to point fingers."

"The emperor is also showing off to the Ai family, isn't he? How long can I live at my age? What's wrong with wanting to see Prince Jing's heir born? Both sons are unfilial..." Scared!What did he...Jing Wang do?How dare he...dare...

"Mother, I will take care of it for you."

No one could see clearly what Shangguan Jing did. They could only see him throwing his hand away, and the two figures were thrown out and twisted when they landed on the ground.

Shangguan Yu's eyes suddenly turned cold, and he looked down at the palace maids who were still lively before but were now pale-faced. One of them had a broken arm and the other had a broken foot. I believe that they would never dare to approach King Jing again in their lifetime, otherwise their necks would probably be broken next.

"Imperial brother, you..." Shangguan Yu was frightened when he saw this. It seemed that if King Jing wanted to kill him, it would be easy, and his fingers as smooth as jade would be the murder weapon.

"Brother, Emperor, Mother, please don't bother with this kind of thing in the future. No matter how beautiful a woman is, she is just a pink skull if she is not loved by her heart. It is useless no matter how much you give me. You value imperial power more than family affection, but that does not mean that I have the same idea. To me, it is just rubbish." He said clearly for the first time that he did not want it. Everyone is fighting for the throne to the death, and it is not as good as his wife's smile.
